title: Portfolio, registry and correspondence operations
walkthrough:
You move between three screens, each with the same dark top bar: the "ANDS Studio" brand (with a small per-page suffix like "· portfolio"), your user chip, and navigation chips "Dossier manager" and "Guided journey →" — the registry and correspondence pages add a "Portfolio" chip. There is no side rail; each page is a single column of glassy cards.

On the Portfolio page the heading "Portfolio" sits over the line "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance." While data loads you see "Loading portfolio…"; if there are none, "No dossiers yet." with the link "Create one in the dossier manager →". Otherwise three big-number cards — "Dossiers", "Ready to file", "Blocked" — then one row per dossier: its ID, title, submission type, a mini module tower, a gate chip ("Ready to file" or a count like "3/5 modules"), and a fee chip ("Fee paid", "Fee waived", or "Fee due" plus an amount; "Fee …" while it loads, since fee status fills in row by row after the list appears). Each row ends with "Open →" and "Viewer" links.

The Product registry page is headed "Product registry" with a "Register product +" button (it flips to "Cancel"). The form asks for "Product name", "Dossier ID", "DIN (8 digits)", "Country" and "Drug type"; a bad DIN returns "A DIN is exactly 8 digits (e.g. 02248808)", and a note explains new registrations start as Submitted. You submit with "Register product →". Empty state: "No registrations yet. Register a product once its dossier reaches NOC." Each registration row shows the DIN (or "DIN pending"), product, country, a linked dossier ID, a status chip, and buttons for allowed moves such as "→ Marketed"; terminal states show "No further transitions". A deadlines strip and an annual obligations checklist also render on this page.

On "Correspondence & notices", a small card holds a "Dossier" field (placeholder "e123456") with an "Open" button. The field is a combo box listing your dossiers, and the first dossier is picked for you automatically once the list loads; if that list fails to load you must type the dossier ID yourself — knowing its format is on you. While no dossier is selected (list empty or unavailable): "Pick a dossier to see its correspondence, notices and NOA clocks." Once one is, three stacked panels appear. "Notice inbox" shows phase and status chips; with no lifecycle started you get a warning and a "Start lifecycle" button with "Submission type" and "Received by HC on" fields. Otherwise you pick a "Notice", set "Date on the notice", optional "HC reference (optional)" and "Subject (optional)", and press an ingest button (e.g. "Ingest SAL"); a hint reads "Screening: SAL / SDN / SRL · Review decisions: NOC / NOD / NON", and a confirmation names the logged record and any response window in days. Below sit the "Correspondence hub" (record count, kind filter, log form) and a Form V / NOA register panel.
